reviews.text:
I can’t recommend Dr. Amro enough. What sets him apart is that every visit feels completely personalized to you rather than focused on chasing typical beauty standards or creating a one-size-fits-all result. He takes the time to understand your features and enhances what already suits you best, while giving honest recommendations on what you actually need.

From the moment you sit down, his hospitality and professionalism make you feel comfortable and at ease. There’s never any pressure, and he explains everything in a way that feels thoughtful and tailored rather than transactional.

One thing I especially appreciate is that his recommendations go beyond procedures. He recommended incorporating peptides into my routine and they’ve genuinely been a game changer for me. It showed me that his approach isn’t about doing more, it’s about choosing what will actually support your goals and give you the best overall outcome.

What I appreciate most is that his approach is very balanced and natural. The goal never feels like changing your face or body it’s about refining and elevating your existing features in a way that still feels like you.

I’ve recommended him to my friends and family without hesitation, and genuinely, he’s the only doctor I would trust to perform any procedure. Finding someone with that level of skill, honesty, and patient care is rare, and it’s why I keep going back.

A very cozy and modern clinic where you truly feel the care and attention of the staff. I really liked the interior design, the rooms, the equipment, and how smoothly the entire process was organized. I came without any prior recommendations, and I feel lucky that I ended up here.
Dr. Miguel Bravo, a plastic surgeon, made the entire surgical process—from the initial consultation and planning to post-operative follow-up—very easy and smooth (with great support from Rasha, Dr. Miguel’s assistant). I initially had some doubts about whether the procedure was necessary, but Dr. Miguel was so kind and professional that all my concerns disappeared. He is a very pleasant person and a doctor I can confidently recommend to anyone. I am extremely happy with the final result.

I can’t recommend Dr. Abdelfatah enough! I’ve had a couple of procedures done with him, and every single time I’ve received outstanding care and achieved the results I was hoping for. He is very understanding, honest, and straightforward. He never recommends unnecessary procedures—he tells you exactly what you need and makes sure you have realistic expectations. That honesty is something I truly appreciate and trust.

I also want to give special recognition to his amazing assistant, Arabiya. She always greets me warmly as soon as I arrive at the hospital and makes me feel so welcome and comfortable. Her kindness and professionalism make every visit a pleasant experience.

A big thank you as well to Nurse Lini. She is incredibly caring, responds very quickly to any questions or concerns, and always goes above and beyond to make sure her patients are well looked after.

The entire team is professional, compassionate, and dedicated to providing the best care. I highly recommend Dr. Abdelfatah and his wonderful team to anyone considering cosmetic procedures.

It has been over a month since my rhinoplasty surgery, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience and results with Dr. Tawfek. I had almost no pain after the surgery and felt very comfortable throughout the recovery process. My healing experience was much easier than I expected. The final look of my nose is exactly what I wanted — natural, elegant, and perfectly suited to my face.

Dr. Tawfek truly listened to me and understood all of my wishes, delivering exactly the result I hoped for. His professionalism and approach made me feel very confident and safe throughout the entire journey. I would also like to specially thank coordinator Hiba and nurse Krishel for being so kind, caring, and supportive.

Everything at the clinic was at an excellent level, and I felt comfortable and well taken care of both before and after the surgery. I’m extremely happy with my experience and would sincerely recommend them to anyone considering rhinoplasty.

I had a wonderful experience with Maria Oleksyk at Elyzee Hospital. Maria is extremely professional, attentive, and clearly very knowledgeable in her field. She took the time to explain every step of the procedure, which helped me feel relaxed and confident.

The treatments were performed with great care and precision, and I could immediately see positive results. I especially appreciated her gentle approach and genuine kindness — it truly made a difference in my overall experience.

I would highly recommend Maria to anyone looking for high-quality care and excellent results. I will definitely be coming back for future procedures.🙌🏻
